chunks: And they said what the first ones said.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say about their predecessors on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the failure of blind imitation (taqlid) when detached from rational conviction, as the disbelievers in the Hereafter attempt to shift blame to their ancestors. It serves as a critique of superficial adherence to tradition, emphasizing that individual accountability remains intact despite following predecessors. The verse thus highlights the transition from collective error to personal responsibility on the Day of Judgment.
